>
[Animal Empathy (Druid)](/Feats.aspx?ID=4709) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Druid" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=583" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 127

**Archetypes** [Beastmaster](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=50) (Level 4), [Mammoth Lord](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=170) (Level 4)

</column>

---

You have a connection to the creatures of the natural world that allows you to communicate with them on a rudimentary level. You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with animals. In most cases, wild animals will give you time to make your case.
name: Animal Empathy (Druid)
